v1.2.2 Update
- Fixed repeated Role, Bio, and Stat content in Arcane Grimoire, Stellar Link, and Adventurer's Ledger.
- Relic, Linked Module, and Quest cards now appear before the remaining Stats and no longer duplicate the Stat they promote.
- Recent Event fallback remains available, while Arcane Grimoire hides an empty Relic card.

announcement.title: 💞 Stylish Relationship Tracker v1.2.2
announcement.content:
Stylish Relationship Tracker v1.2.2 fixes repeated Profile and Stat content in three themes.

  • Arcane Grimoire, Stellar Link, and Adventurer's Ledger no longer repeat the active Relationship's Role as a tag or reuse its Profile Bio for a secondary card.
  • The first populated Stat is shown once as the theme's Relic, Linked Module, or Quest card. That card now appears before the remaining Stats.
  • Recent Event content still fills the secondary card when no Stat is available, and Arcane Grimoire hides the Relic card when neither source has content.
